content.title: Review idea: investigate flaky frontend e2e tests (parent-selector, copy-token)
content.description: Triage decision needed for idea mqe1drwrck. The webapp-developer reported two intermittent frontend e2e failures distinct from the backend shared-state flakiness (mqe0745gy7): (1) phase3 parent-selector 'changes an existing parent' — waitForResponse timeout, likely sensitive to accumulated data volume (>100 issues by phase3); (2) phase4 copy-token 'copy button changes to check icon' — clipboard timing in headless mode. Both pass in isolation. See the idea for suggested mitigation options. Please decide: ACCEPT (fix as a chore/test-hygiene task), NEEDS REFINEMENT, or DISCARD. If accept, note the scope/owner so the PM can plan implementation children.

content.content:
TRIAGE DECISION: ACCEPT — as a chore/test-hygiene task (no product behavior change). I read both flake sites in the code and confirm the diagnosis; both are real, distinct from the backend shared-state fix already landed in mqe0745gy7 (workers:1 serialization, which should stay).

Root cause confirmation:
1. parent-selector (phase3-validation.spec.ts:1287, 'changes an existing parent') — the waitForResponse at :1347 (search result) is attached AFTER searchInput.fill() at :1344 and uses a loose matcher (url includes '/api/issues' + 'search='). This can latch onto a stale/debounced prior search response or miss an already-fired one — a classic attach-order race, made worse when >100 issues slow/clutter the search response. Real.
2. copy-token (phase4-validation.spec.ts:748, 'copy button changes to check icon') — the suite grants NO clipboard permissions anywhere; handleCopyToken (frontend/src/pages/UsersPage.tsx:64) calls navigator.clipboard.writeText() unguarded, which can throw/reject under headless Chromium and abort the handler before setTokenCopied(true), so the check icon never appears. Compounded by the suite's shortest assertion timeout (3000ms at :793). Real.

Recommended scope for the PM to break into implementation children (all low-risk, test-only):

Task A — Stabilize parent-selector test. Scope the waitForResponse matcher to the specific request (method + the unique search term / parent2Id) AND set up the response promise before the action that triggers it; alternatively assert on the result-row selector (button hasText parent2Id) rather than the network response. Removes the stale-response race.

Task B — Stabilize copy-token test. Grant clipboard permission via Playwright (test.use({ permissions: { clipboard: {} } }) on the test, or in the chromium project in playwright.config.ts) and bump the check-icon assertion timeout from 3000ms to the suite standard (>=5000ms). Optional hardening: guard handleCopyToken against a missing navigator.clipboard (defensive, not required).

Suggested owner: webapp-validator (E2E/Playwright flakiness is its domain; Task B touches a frontend handler but only as defensive hardening). Suggested priority: keep at 3 — test hygiene, not product-blocking. Both tasks are independent and can be parallelized under parent idea mqe1drwrck.
